setup.en: Opus 5.5 (effort medium) plans, codes, tests and iterates by itself.
setup.zh: Opus 5.5（effort medium）自己规划、写码、测试、迭代。

notes.en: Lean, clean code (IIFE + strict). Boss fight too punishing; two text overlaps.
notes.zh: 代码精简干净（IIFE + strict）。Boss 战惩罚过重，有两处文字重叠。

label.zh: Opus 写 spec + DeepSeek 写码

setup.en: Opus 5.5 writes a 271-line spec only. DeepSeek (deepseek-flash, via DeepSeek Harness) implements it in one run. Opus never reviews.
setup.zh: Opus 5.5 只写 271 行 spec，DeepSeek（deepseek-flash，经 DeepSeek Harness）一次跑完实现，Opus 不 review。

notes.en: Richest content: synthwave grid, 5 power-ups, combos, boss drops. Code in global scope, twice as long.
notes.zh: 内容最丰富：合成波网格、5 种道具、连击、boss 掉道具。代码全局作用域，长度翻倍。

setup.en: Same as A, with effort raised to high.
setup.zh: 和 A 组相同，effort 调到 high。

label.zh: Opus 写 spec + Kimi 写码

setup.en: The exact spec from group B, handed to Kimi k3.1-pro (Kimi Code CLI). Only the coder changes. Cost includes the reused Opus spec ($0.97) plus Kimi ($0.81).
setup.zh: 直接用 B 组那份 spec，交给 Kimi k3.1-pro（Kimi Code CLI），只换写码模型。成本含复用的 Opus spec（$0.97）和 Kimi（$0.81）。

setup.en: Kimi k3.1-pro gets only the requirement and works like group A.
setup.zh: Kimi k3.1-pro 只拿到需求原文，和 A 组一样独立完成。

original.en: Reddit original (5-level pixel platformer): Opus alone 16 min / $2.52 / 25 of 25; Opus + local Qwen 42 min / $0.62 / 24 of 25.
original.zh: Reddit 原帖（5 关像素平台跳跃）：Opus 单干 16 分钟 / $2.52 / 25/25；Opus + 本地 Qwen 42 分钟 / $0.62 / 24/25。
